title: マイルCSの後に・大団円

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki, Biko Pegasus, and Hishi Akebono finish the Mile Championship in a blaze of glory. They grin at each other in satisfied exhaustion after running their hearts out in a fierce struggle for first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their positive emotions touch the hearts of the audience too. Even the younger racer who has been watching Fuji Kiseki is moved to tears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, she asks to participate in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, a 1,200-meter G1 turf sprint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm puzzled by her straightforward suggestion considering how much of a trickster she usually is, but she must have a reason.
